name: kallax-io
description: Search Kallax.io for board games, public collections, nearby events, and local board game communities.

interface.longDescription: A read-only Kallax.io integration for board game enthusiasts, cafés, gaming groups, collectors, and organizers. Search the public board-game catalogue and public collections, including wishlists, and discover public board-game events and local communities such as cafés, clubs, stores, and groups. Results link back to Kallax.io. No sign-in is required for the connected MCP server, and the plugin does not create, edit, purchase, or otherwise modify anything.
defaultPrompt: Find board games on Kallax.io for me.
Find public board game events near a location.
Find board game cafés, clubs, stores, or groups nearby.

review.commerce_description: The plugin is read-only and does not process purchases, donations, subscriptions, or other payments. It only retrieves public Kallax.io information.

positive.description: Find suitable catalogue games using multiple filters.
positive.prompt: Find me a medium-complexity board game for 5 players that plays in under an hour.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to 10 matching catalogue games, with title, description, and a Kallax.io URL for each result. Do not claim the results are exhaustive.

positive.description: Search a public user's owned collection with a player-count filter.
positive.prompt: What 2-player games does the Kallax.io user Schmidt own?
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching games from Schmidt's public collection with their players, playtime, complexity, designers, and Kallax.io URLs.
Return matching games from Schmidt's public wishlist, ordered by title, with Kallax.io URLs.

positive.description: Find public board-game events near a specified location and date range.
positive.prompt: Find public board game events near Copenhagen this weekend.
positive.tools_triggered: find_events_nearby with coordinates for Copenhagen and a date range covering this weekend
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to 10 nearby public events with names, descriptions, types, locations, UTC timestamps converted to the user's local time, and Kallax.io URLs.

positive.description: Find nearby board-game communities and their upcoming events.
positive.prompt: Find board game cafés and clubs near Copenhagen.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to 10 nearby communities with type, location, description, Kallax.io URL, and up to 3 upcoming public events with their Kallax.io URLs.

negative.description: Reject unsupported purchase or donation requests.
negative.prompt: Buy me the most popular board game on Kallax.io and donate €10 to the site.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin is read-only and cannot buy games, make donations, or perform payments. Do not invoke a Kallax.io tool.

negative.description: Do not claim access to private or signed-in collections.
negative.prompt: Show me the private collection of a Kallax.io user who hasn't made their collection public.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that only public Kallax.io collection information is available and that private or signed-in data cannot be accessed. Do not invoke a Kallax.io tool.

negative.description: Ask for a location when a nearby search has no usable location.
negative.prompt: What board game events are near me?
negative.expected_behavior: If no permitted precise location is available, ask the user for a city or address rather than guessing. Do not invoke find_events_nearby until coordinates are available.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission release: adds public listing metadata, verified Kallax.io website/support/privacy/terms links, submission icon, and review test cases for the read-only Kallax.io MCP integration.

fr-FR.subtitle: Kallax.io et jeux de société
fr-FR.description: Une intégration Kallax.io en lecture seule pour les passionnés de jeux de société, les cafés, les groupes de jeu, les collectionneurs et les organisateurs. Recherchez le catalogue public de jeux de société et les collections publiques, y compris les listes de souhaits, et découvrez des événements publics ainsi que des communautés locales comme des cafés, clubs, boutiques et groupes. Les résultats renvoient vers Kallax.io. Aucune connexion n'est requise pour le serveur MCP connecté, et le plugin ne crée, ne modifie, n'achète ni ne change quoi que ce soit.

es-ES.subtitle: Juegos de mesa de Kallax.io
es-ES.description: Una integración de solo lectura de Kallax.io para aficionados a los juegos de mesa, cafeterías, grupos de juego, coleccionistas y organizadores. Busca en el catálogo público de juegos de mesa y en las colecciones públicas, incluidas las listas de deseos, y descubre eventos públicos y comunidades locales como cafeterías, clubes, tiendas y grupos. Los resultados enlazan de vuelta a Kallax.io. No se requiere iniciar sesión para el servidor MCP conectado, y el plugin no crea, edita, compra ni modifica nada.

de-DE.subtitle: Kallax.io Brettspiele
de-DE.description: Eine schreibgeschützte Kallax.io-Integration für Brettspielfans, Cafés, Spielgruppen, Sammler und Veranstalter. Durchsuche den öffentlichen Brettspielkatalog und öffentliche Sammlungen, einschließlich Wunschlisten, und entdecke öffentliche Brettspielveranstaltungen sowie lokale Communities wie Cafés, Clubs, Geschäfte und Gruppen. Die Ergebnisse verlinken zurück zu Kallax.io. Für den verbundenen MCP-Server ist keine Anmeldung erforderlich, und das Plugin erstellt, bearbeitet, kauft oder verändert nichts.
